facts: About 27,000 people in the commune and 124,000 in the urban area (2022)
On Tahiti, in the Windward Islands
worth_knowing: The name means "water from a basket", a result of a naming taboo under Pōmare I that replaced the word vai for water with pape. It is the hub of the territory's tourism and a common port of call.
